title: 第2章 我的人生没有放弃！
content_zh:
虽说还没有完全搞清楚到底血脉有着怎样的蜕变，有一点可以确定，继续下去，至少还有希望，甚至可能会有意想不到的变化。

滴血炼兵，先化人形，后又熔炼，在燕听雨熟练的手法之下，那金属水最终熔炼成一口约有半米长的利剑。

利剑薄如蝉翼，有着血色的纹线，就仿佛鲜血流动的脉络一样，轻轻一弹，颤动如同一汪秋水在律动，发出铮鸣之音，十分悦耳。

“这已经超出了普通兵器的范畴，放在精品兵器内，也算是中等偏上了。”燕听雨最是熟悉兵器，看着手中的利剑，俏脸儿上掩饰不住的震惊，“这是最普通材料打造的，只因你秦政的一滴血带来的变化，此事若是说出去，怕是会引起神武大陆所有炼兵师一致怀疑的，若非我亲手打造的，我自己都无法相信。”

普通材料炼制出精品兵器，更是在炼制中，血色化作透明的，甚至有滴血化人的奇异一幕，无不在表明秦政的血脉的确有了巨大的蜕变。

秦政略微激动之后，便恢复了平静。

“与我而言，这也仅仅证明我的血脉不凡，并不能表明我的武道之路会被打开的。”秦政心里想的还是武道之路。

“那也未必，武道之路修行，首要是武脉。”燕听雨盯着秦政，很认真的道，“你的血也许就是武脉。”

武脉，有许多种类，并非是单纯的武者丹田内勾勒出来的如同蜘蛛网的武脉，还有很多特殊武脉。

比如说天蝠武脉，这类武脉并不是在丹田内，而是胸腹之间的经脉勾勒成蝙蝠状的样子，那是承载武道力量的根本，并且能够在修炼达到一定程度之后，激发天蝠武脉内孕育的奥妙，演化出某种神通，例如蝙蝠翼等等。

还有类似的炎龙武脉，那是隐藏在右臂骨骼内的武脉，修炼有成之后，右臂会化作炎龙臂，成为攻杀利器。

诸如此类的特殊武脉，还是不少的。

秦政也曾对自己抱有幻想，觉得可能他的武脉是在血脉内，隐藏于血中，只是还未到达顶点，引发出来而已。

只是后来在刻意的向东海王府中的侍卫长等高端武者询问，才知道，武脉有隐藏的，但不会阻挠突破境界，像肉身境界冲入力武境，那些隐藏的武脉顶多会令修炼者难以发现在何处，可是一旦实力到了，自然突破的，并没有似秦政这般的，始终无法真正完成突破。

想到这里，原本有些期待的秦政就是一皱眉。

“泄气了？想放弃？”燕听雨轻声道。

“放弃？”秦政愕然指着自己的鼻子，“我是秦政，我的人生中从没有放弃！”

燕听雨道：“你该知道，三百次的突破跌落境界，的确让你的血脉发生了质变，但并不见得一定是为你打开了武道之门，当然了，也许你继续修炼下去，是有机会，但可能需要一千次，三千次，上万次，甚至到了你生命的终点，你都难以引出你的武脉，始终在不间断的突破跌落境界中渡过一生，你还打算继续？”

秦政笑了，“听雨，你该知道我的性格，别说现在还有一线希望，当初完全没希望，我都能坚持三百次，三百次是多少年？”他看着那利剑，轻轻弹动，传来清脆的剑鸣声，淡淡的道，“我曾经有过放弃的念头，沮丧过，颓废过，都一一坚持下来了，我这颗武道之心早已经磨砺的坚不可摧了。”

“那我就不劝你专修炼兵师了。”燕听雨见秦政如此坚定，也有点泄气了，在她看来，秦政的血对炼制兵器有着如此神妙的作用，也许是天生的炼兵师呢，怎奈秦政认定武道之路，不管她怎么引导，就是对炼兵师没兴趣。

“我倒是觉得你可以继续诱导我，不过，你的办法不对，所以始终没让我生出兴趣罢了。”秦政习惯性的用右手食指摸了摸鼻尖。

秦政走了两步，到了门前，道：“你想啊诱导嘛，关键在那个诱字上面，美色诱惑啊，不穿衣服的诱惑……”

没等他说完，燕听雨张牙舞爪的扑了上去，尖叫道：“秦……政！”

等燕听雨追出来，只听到秦政的声音在回荡着，“我等着你来诱惑我。”

气的燕听雨跺跺脚，随后又忍不住笑了起来。

返回途中，秦政的心情还是不错的。

虽不能说明能够打开武道之门，却也是给秦政一个希望。

秦政性格就在于此，认准了，就绝不放手。

他已经在思索着接下来的日子，要继续苦心修炼，争取第三百零一次的突破。

进入东海王府，尚未到达玉莲院，就能听到玉莲院内高谈阔论，声音有些嘈杂，其中一个声音，秦政一下就听出来了，正是当代东海王的二儿子秦逸，是大炎帝都最有名的纨绔子弟之一，最是骄横跋扈。

步入玉莲院，就见一袭锦袍的秦逸坐在玉莲花池旁的赏花亭内，左右七八个家奴正七嘴八舌的说着什么，见秦政到来，都闭上了嘴巴。

“你这狗奴才干什么去了，让小王我等了这许久。”秦逸斜视着秦政，不待秦政回话，便继续说道，“小王我宽宏大量，不跟你这狗奴才计较，以后记住，不要以为你爹为我爷爷而死，就觉得高人一等。”他扇子点指秦政的额头，“你就是奴才，连狗都不如的奴才，让你待在玉莲院已经是对你的恩赐了，不要真的以为见到主子不用行礼，过来，给我跪下，然后将我爷爷留给你的东西双手奉上。”

“小王爷，恕我难以从命。”秦政道。

老东海王临终前曾送给秦政一个铁盒子，并且告诉他，非到东海王府遇到危难时，绝对不能打开，且不得告诉任何人有铁盒子之事。

对于此事，秦政始终不解，此事看上去极其不合理，但老东海王遗言如此，他也不敢等闲视之。

何况遵循遗言更是对老东海王的尊重，当然不可能交给这纨绔子弟秦逸了。

看看秦逸身旁几个尖嘴猴腮，眼珠子贼光四射的家奴，秦政估计，很可能是自己检查铁盒子是否丢失的时候，被这几个人给看到的，好在他已经将铁盒子换地方了，也不怕他们搜查玉莲院。

“什么！”秦逸用扇子猛然敲打石桌，豁然站起，“你竟敢违背小王我的命令。”

“秦政不敢，我只是奉老王爷的遗命行事。”秦政不卑不亢的道。

“少拿老王爷来压我，我就问你一句话，你给还是不给。”秦逸冷冷的道。

秦逸那张俊朗的面孔露出冷冽之色，狰狞的道：“你信不信我打死你。”

秦政的回答干脆利落，半点犹豫也无。

秦逸气的火冒三丈，杀气腾腾的道：“那我便打死你。”

秦政站在那里没动，只是平静的道：“小王爷，这里是玉莲院，你若打我，必然惊动外面的人，王爷定然会知晓的。”

举起棒子的秦逸咬了咬牙，终是没敢出手，他很清楚，当今东海王，也就是他的父亲对秦政很是善待的，若是因为自己强抢老东海王留给秦政的东西，被知道了，估计他会遭到严厉惩罚的。

“行，行，你这狗奴才真的翻天了。”秦逸用棒子一头点在秦政的额头上，“狗奴才，你给我记住了，三天，就给你三天时间，如果你不主动跪在我面前，将铁盒子交给我，我就要你死。”他凑近秦政的面前，森森的道，“要你这狗奴才死，我有一百种办法，你最好给我想清楚。”

秦逸带着人离开了，在门口，还不忘回头向秦政竖起三根手指，“三天，你就只有三天的时间！”

他一巴掌拍在那石桌上面，气恨秦逸的同时，也是恼恨自己怎么就那么不小心，被人发现了铁盒子的存在。

懊恼归懊恼，现在的问题是，秦逸这纨绔说得出做得到，也许不敢光明正大的杀了他，可玩点小手段还是很轻松的。

丝丝疼痛感从右手掌心传来，秦政拿起手一看，却是之前要验证血脉变化，划破右手掌心取一滴精血的时候，留下的伤口，因用力拍桌子，伤口裂开了，他取药治疗，眼角余光却发现掌心流出来的一丝鲜血竟然渗透进入石桌了，并且令石桌表面散发出点点光晕，更是有字迹若隐若现。

秦政先是一愣，随即快速的关闭玉莲院门，抱起石桌进入自己的房间，以他肉身境界顶峰的实力，力气还是非常惊人的，抱走石桌也不费力，关闭门窗，再看那石桌，就见上面的字迹已经清晰起来，他辨认一下，读道：“九色神莲经，神武大陆三大武经之一，修成此经，可打破人神桎梏，成为与日月同在的神，欲修此经，与武脉无关……”
content_en:
Although it is not yet completely clear what kind of transformation the bloodline has undergone, one thing is certain. If it continues, there is at least hope, and there may even be unexpected changes.

To refine the weapon with blood, it was first transformed into a human form, and then smelted. Under Yan Tingyu's skillful techniques, the metallic water was finally smelted into a sharp sword about half a meter long.

The sword is as thin as a cicada's wing, with blood-colored lines, just like the veins of blood flowing. With a flick, it trembles like the rhythm of a pool of autumn water, making a clanking sound, which is very pleasant to the ear.

"This has gone beyond the scope of ordinary weapons. It is considered to be above average among high-quality weapons." Yan Tingyu is most familiar with weapons. He looked at the sharp sword in his hand and couldn't hide the shock on his pretty face. "This is made of the most ordinary materials. It is only because of the changes brought about by a drop of your Qin Zheng's blood. If this matter is told, I am afraid it will arouse the unanimous suspicion of all the weapon refiners in the Shenwu Continent. If I hadn't made it myself, I wouldn't be able to believe it."

Ordinary materials were used to refine high-quality weapons, and during the refining process, the blood color turned transparent, and there was even a strange scene where a drop of blood transformed into a human being, which all showed that Qin Zheng's bloodline had indeed undergone a huge transformation.

Qin Zheng regained his composure after being slightly agitated.

"For me, this only proves that my bloodline is extraordinary. It does not mean that my path to martial arts will be opened." What Qin Zheng was thinking about was the path to martial arts.

"That's not necessarily true. When practicing martial arts, the first priority is martial veins." Yan Tingyu stared at Qin Zheng and said seriously, "Maybe your blood is martial veins."

There are many types of martial veins, not just the spider web-like martial veins outlined in a warrior's dantian, but also many special martial veins.

For example, the Sky Bat Martial Vein is not located in the Dantian, but the meridians between the chest and abdomen are outlined in the shape of a bat. It is the foundation that carries the power of martial arts, and after reaching a certain level of practice, it can stimulate the mystery bred in the Sky Bat Martial Vein and evolve certain magical powers, such as bat wings and so on.

There is also a similar Flame Dragon Martial Vein, which is a Martial Vein hidden in the bones of the right arm. After successful cultivation, the right arm will turn into a Flame Dragon Arm and become a weapon for attack and killing.

There are still many special martial arts like this.

Qin Zheng also had fantasies about himself, thinking that maybe his martial arts was in his blood, hidden in the blood, but it had not reached its peak and was triggered.

It was only later that I deliberately asked high-end warriors such as the captain of the guard in the East China Sea Palace that I learned that there are hidden martial arts, but they will not hinder the breakthrough. Just like breaking into the physical realm from the physical realm, those hidden martial arts will at most make it difficult for practitioners to find where they are. However, once the strength is reached, there will be a natural breakthrough. There is no such thing as Qin Zheng, who has never been able to truly complete the breakthrough.

Thinking of this, Qin Zheng, who had been looking forward to it, frowned.

"Are you discouraged? Do you want to give up?" Yan Tingyu said softly.

"Give up?" Qin Zheng pointed to his nose in shock, "I am Qin Zheng, and I have never given up in my life!"

Yan Tingyu said: "You should know that three hundred breakthroughs and falls have indeed caused a qualitative change in your bloodline, but it does not necessarily open the door to martial arts for you. Of course, you may have a chance if you continue to practice, but it may take a thousand, three thousand, or tens of thousands of times. Even at the end of your life, you will be unable to draw out your martial arts. You have always spent your life in the non-stop breakthroughs and falls. Do you plan to continue?"

Qin Zheng smiled, "Ting Yu, you should know my character. Not to mention that there is a glimmer of hope now. There was no hope at all. I was able to persevere three hundred times. How many years is three hundred times?" He looked at the sharp sword, flicking lightly, and heard the crisp sound of the sword. He said lightly, "I have had the idea of giving up, been frustrated, and decadent, but I have persisted one by one. My martial arts heart has been honed to an indestructible state."

"Then I won't advise you to specialize in training as a weapon master." Yan Tingyu was a little discouraged when she saw Qin Zheng's determination. In her opinion, Qin Zheng's blood has such a magical effect on refining weapons. Maybe he is a natural weapon refiner. However, Qin Zheng decided that the path of martial arts was not interested in being a weapon refiner, no matter how she guided him.

"I think you can continue to induce me, but your method is wrong, so I never got interested." Qin Zheng habitually touched the tip of his nose with his right index finger.

Qin Zheng took two steps and arrived in front of the door and said: "You want to induce, the key is the word lure, the temptation of beauty, the temptation of not wearing clothes..."

Before he could finish speaking, Yan Tingyu pounced on him with all his teeth and claws, screaming: "Qin... Zheng!"

When Yan Tingyu chased him out, he heard Qin Zheng's voice echoing, "I'm waiting for you to seduce me."

Yan Tingyu stomped his feet in anger, and then couldn't help but laugh.

On the way back, Qin Zheng was still in a good mood.

Although it does not mean that it can open the door to martial arts, it does give Qin Zheng a hope.

This is Qin Zheng's character. Once he sees it, he will never let it go.

He is already thinking about the next days, and he will continue to practice hard and strive for the 301st breakthrough.

Entering the Palace of the East China Sea, before arriving at the Yulian Courtyard, you can hear the loud and noisy talk in the Yulian Courtyard. One of the voices was immediately recognized by Qin Zheng. It was Qin Yi, the second son of the contemporary King of the East China Sea. He was one of the most famous playboys in the capital of Emperor Yan, and the most arrogant and domineering.

Entering the Jade Lotus Courtyard, they saw Qin Yi in a brocade robe sitting in the flower-viewing pavilion next to the Jade Lotus Pond. Seven or eight servants on the left and right were chattering. When Qin Zheng arrived, they all closed their mouths.

"What are you doing, little Wang, for making me wait for so long?" Qin Yi squinted at Qin Zheng, and continued without waiting for Qin Zheng's reply, "Xiao Wang, I am magnanimous and won't argue with you, a dog slave. Remember in the future, don't think that your father died for my grandfather, just because you are superior.Wait." He pointed his fan at Qin Zheng's forehead, "You are a slave, even worse than a dog.Letting you stay in Yulian Court is already a gift to you. Don't really think that you don't need to bow when you see the master. Come here, kneel down and give me what my grandfather left for you."

"Young prince, please forgive me for not obeying my order." Qin Zheng said.

Before his death, the old King of Donghai gave Qin Zheng an iron box and told him that he must not open it unless the Donghai Palace was in danger, and he must not tell anyone about the iron box.

Qin Zheng has always been puzzled by this matter. It seems extremely unreasonable, but with the last words of the old King of Donghai, he dare not take it lightly.

What's more, following the last words is a sign of respect for the old King of Donghai. Of course, it is impossible to leave it to this playboy Qin Yi.

Looking at the servants with sharp mouths and monkey cheeks and gleaming eyes next to Qin Yi, Qin Zheng estimated that he was probably seen by these people when he was checking whether the iron box was missing. Fortunately, he had already moved the iron box to another place, and he was not afraid of them searching the Yulian Courtyard.

"What!" Qin Yi slammed the stone table with his fan and stood up suddenly, "How dare you disobey my order, Xiao Wang."

"Qin Zheng doesn't dare, I'm just acting on the old prince's orders." Qin Zheng said neither humble nor overbearing.

"Don't use the old prince to pressure me. I'm going to ask you a question, will you give it or not." Qin Yi said coldly.

Qin Yi's handsome face showed a cold look, and he said ferociously: "Believe it or not, I will beat you to death."

Qin Zheng's answer was crisp and clear, without any hesitation.

Qin Yi was furious and said with murderous intent: "Then I will beat you to death."

Qin Zheng stood there without moving, and just said calmly: "Little prince, this is the Jade Lotus Courtyard. If you hit me, you will definitely alert people outside, and the prince will definitely know."

Qin Yi, who raised the stick, gritted his teeth and finally did not dare to take action. He knew very well that the current King of East China Sea, his father, was very kind to Qin Zheng. If it was known that he had robbed the things left by the old King of East China Sea to Qin Zheng, he would probably be severely punished.

"Okay, okay, you dog slave has really changed the world." Qin Yi pointed the end of the stick on Qin Zheng's forehead, "Dog slave, remember this, three days, I will give you three days. If you don't take the initiative to kneel in front of me and hand over the iron box to me, I will kill you." He approached Qin Zheng and said solemnly, "I have a hundred ways to kill you, dog slave. You'd better think of it clearly for me."

Qin Yi led the people away. At the door, he turned around and raised three fingers to Qin Zheng, "Three days, you only have three days!"

He slapped the stone table. While he was angry at Qin Yi, he was also angry at himself for being so careless and someone discovered the existence of the iron box.

Annoyance is annoyance, the problem now is that Qin Yi, a playboy, can do it, but he may not dare to kill him openly, but it is still easy to use some tricks.

A slight pain came from the palm of his right hand. Qin Zheng picked up his hand and took a look. It was the wound left when he scratched the palm of his right hand to take a drop of blood essence to verify the changes in the blood. He slapped the table hard and the wound opened. He took medicine to treat it, but out of the corner of his eye, he noticed that a trace of blood flowing out of the palm had penetrated into the stone table, and caused the surface of the stone table to emit a little halo, and there were even fainter writings.

Qin Zheng was stunned for a moment, then quickly closed the door of Jade Lotus Courtyard, picked up the stone table and entered his room. With his strength at the peak of the physical realm, his strength was still very amazing.The handwriting on it had become clear. He recognized it and read: "The Nine-Colored Divine Lotus Sutra is one of the three major martial arts sutras in the Shenwu Continent. Completing this sutra can break the shackles of humans and gods and become a god who coexists with the sun and the moon. If you want to cultivate this sutra, it has nothing to do with martial arts..."
